blocks.lead: ZPUI enables bypassing blocks on Discord, YouTube and other resources with one click. Everything is automated: the engine, the strategy for your provider and recovery after failures.

list: Status cards — Zapret, Proxy, Xbox DNS: state and version of each module.
Availability indicator — how well blocked resources open right now.
The Zapret power button — the main button of the app.

steps: The first-run wizard checks your system and downloads the bypass engine (internet required).
Auto-select tests strategies and applies the best one for your provider.
Done — Discord, YouTube and other resources work.

blocks.text: If bypass stops working — click the lightning icon in the sidebar to re-run auto-select: providers change their equipment, so the strategy needs to be picked again.
The app is free, with no ads or telemetry. News — in our Telegram channel, help — in the group (links in the “About” section).

blocks.lead: The main screen: bypass and network state at a glance.

list: Three cards: Zapret, Proxy and DNS — status, port/strategy, colored activity dot.
Clicking a card opens the tab of the corresponding service.
Overall resource availability percentage + breakdown into standard and custom lists.
Re-check button and the time of the last check.
A chart for the last 2 hours and a list of the most problematic resources — you can add an exception for a failing resource or open it in the checker.
If your provider substitutes video server addresses, a banner with an “Enable Xbox DNS” button appears at the top — one click and video works again.

blocks.text: In power-saving mode with medium/max level, monitoring is paused — the tab turns gray with an explanation.

blocks.lead: The main module. It modifies network packets so that the provider's equipment lets traffic to blocked sites through. Enabled with one button.

list: The big button on the Zapret tab turns the bypass on and off — the state is shown next to the button and in the status bar at the bottom of the window.
If the engine crashes, the app will try to restore it on its own: it shows a recovery window with steps, restarts itself on failure and tries again.
Each strategy is its own way of disguising traffic. What works for a friend may not work for you: providers use different equipment.
The colored dot on a strategy card is the result of its last test: green (great), yellow (partial), red (not working).
Strategies can only be changed while Zapret is running — click the card.
Right-click a strategy card → “Test this strategy” — runs a test for it only and refreshes the color indicator (without a full auto-select).
The lightning in the sidebar — auto-select: it iterates all strategies and enables the best one.

After a full auto-select the app checks YouTube at the DNS level: if the provider substitutes addresses, Xbox DNS is enabled automatically and the check repeats — you can see the before/after difference during the run.
AutoSwitch (the gear next to the AutoSwitch toggle) — if the current strategy “dies”, the app tries another one by itself.
The “Lists” tab — domain editing: custom lists and resource-check exceptions.
Game filter — process game UDP traffic separately (all/TCP/UDP).
The ipset filter and list update buttons — for fine-tuning.
By default the engine runs as a process inside the app.
Service mode (the “Settings” tab) is more reliable: the engine keeps working even if the UI has problems.

blocks.text: Do not run a third-party Zapret at the same time as ZPUI — it will cause a conflict and loss of internet.

blocks.lead: The “Proxy” tab has two panels: SOCKS5 (bypass for any devices in your home network) and Telegram MTProto (fast Telegram on PC and phone via this computer).

blocks.h: SOCKS5: bypass on a phone or TV

steps: Enable Zapret — bypass must work on the computer.
Enable the Proxy on the “Proxy” tab.
On the phone: Settings → Wi-Fi → proxy → manual → computer IP, port 1080.
Check: open a blocked site on the phone.

blocks.text: The computer's IP is shown on the “Proxy” tab. Username and password can be left empty. The phone and the computer must be on the same network (one router).

steps: Enable the Proxy — the Telegram bridge starts together with SOCKS5.
Click “Connect in Telegram” — Telegram opens and offers to add the proxy.
Done: Telegram goes through the bridge and loads faster.

blocks.h: Telegram on the phone via QR code

steps: Click “Connect phone” — a window with a QR code opens.
Scan the code with the phone camera — the proxy page opens.
On that page click “Connect in Telegram” — Telegram opens and adds the proxy from this PC.

blocks.text: The phone must be on the same Wi-Fi network as the computer. If LAN access is disabled — the QR window will offer to enable it with one button.

list: The secret — the proxy key. “Refresh” generates a new one: previous connections will have to be added again.
Fake TLS — disguises Telegram traffic as regular HTTPS (for strict blocking).
Statistics — active connections and traffic through the bridge.

blocks.lead: The pulse of your bypass: which resources open, at what speed, and who is connected through the proxy.

list: Availability — resource checks across three layers (TCP, TLS, HTTP) with history.
Speed — current download and upload of the internet (counters for the app session).
YouTube — a separate DNS-level check: if the provider substitutes addresses and video does not open, a banner with an “Enable Xbox DNS” button appears on the dashboard.
Devices — phones and tablets connected via SOCKS5 and the Telegram bridge.
Checking a specific site — the magnifier in the sidebar.

blocks.text: If availability drops below the threshold — AutoSwitch kicks in (if enabled on the “Zapret” tab). In power-saving mode with monitoring disabled the tab is gray: services are paused.

blocks.lead: Changes your computer's DNS servers to xbox-dns.ru (111.88.96.50 and 111.88.96.51) to bypass Xbox Live and other service blocks at the DNS level.

steps: Open the Xbox DNS tab.
Turn on the switch — the DNS is applied automatically.
On the Xbox console itself, follow the instructions on the tab (5 steps).

blocks.text: After turning it off, the DNS automatically returns to your provider's settings (DHCP).

blocks.lead: For laptops: reduces the app's background activity to use less battery. Zapret, proxy and DNS operation is not affected.

list: The main toggle enables the mode. While it is off — no saving happens, no matter what the battery does.
Saving level: Low — less frequent polls and checks; Medium — plus a pause of traffic monitoring and statistics; Max — plus a pause of the device list and operator detection.

Trigger on charge — shown only on laptops: “On battery” (default — the mode is active the whole time on battery, turns off when charging), “Always” or a 10–50% threshold in 5% steps. With a threshold selected the mode turns on when the charge drops to it and turns off by itself when charging. On a PC without a battery, enabling the mode activates it immediately.
The battery icon at the bottom of the sidebar — the mode is active now (always visible while it runs).
The “Monitor” tab turns gray with an explanation — its background services are paused (Medium and above).
Speed counters on the dashboard freeze at zero — traffic monitoring is paused (Medium and above).

blocks.text: Everything returns automatically: on exiting the mode or plugging in the charger, background services and intervals are restored without a restart.

blocks.lead: Problem diagnostics: a report for support and detailed logs of all modules.

steps: Open the “Report” tab.
Click “Generate” — the report is built in the window. The “Save” button writes the MD file to disk; “Print/PDF” — to send it as a document.
Attach the report to your message in the support group — it helps us help you faster.

list: The sheet icon in the sidebar — browsing logs by category: app, zapret, updates, Telegram.
Text search and a level filter (INFO/WARN/ERROR).
The export button — a ZIP archive of logs; the clear button is highlighted red as a dangerous action.

blocks.lead: Appearance, app behavior, updates and Zapret service management.

list: Theme: system, light or dark (also switchable with the button in the window title bar). Language: Russian or English.
Autostart — ZPUI starts with the computer (with administrator rights, no UAC prompt).
Minimize to tray — hide the window instead of closing; “Start minimized”.
Power-saving mode — laptop settings (see the “Power-saving mode” section).
Notifications are always on: errors, service failures, updates and availability drops — no separate setting needed.
Resource check interval — how often availability is measured.

Updates — ZPUI and Zapret cards: clicking the version opens “what's new”, the “Download” button opens a window with download progress, then “Install”. The “Versions” button on the Zapret card — a list of available versions from Yandex.Disk and GitHub: any of them can be installed manually (a rollback to a previous version).
Service — install/remove the engine service mode; “Full reinstall” re-downloads Zapret from scratch.

blocks.text: ZPUI update: the app will close and launch the installer — just finish the installation. Zapret updates right inside the app.

blocks.lead: The most common problems and how to solve them.

blocks.text: Turn off Zapret on the “Zapret” tab. If the internet does not come back — restart the computer. Zapret automatically restores network settings when turned off.

steps: Make sure Zapret is enabled.
Run auto-select (the lightning icon in the sidebar).
Open Diagnostics — check for conflicts.
Flush the DNS cache: open cmd and run ipconfig /flushdns.

blocks.h: Sites open but YouTube video does not

blocks.text: In newer Zapret versions (1.10.x) YouTube may require Xbox DNS: the provider substitutes video server addresses, and Zapret itself cannot bypass that — a clean resolver is needed. Enable Xbox DNS (the tab or the dashboard card). If the “Enable Xbox DNS” banner appeared on the dashboard — this is exactly that case: the app detected the substitution by itself.

blocks.h: The proxy does not work on the phone

list: Make sure the phone and the computer are on the same Wi-Fi network.
For SOCKS5, check that the Windows firewall is not blocking port 1080.
For Telegram, use the QR code — it enables LAN access by itself.
An error code like UPD-EXXX hints at the cause: download, unpacking, integrity, etc.
Copy the code and the error text to the support group — we will help.

blocks.text: Check the logs/boot.log file in the app folder or %TEMP%/zpui-boot.log — there may be an error description there.

blocks.lead: Navigation and quick access to tools. Here is what the icons mean.

list: Section icons — switching between the app's tabs.
Lightning — strategy auto-select: it iterates all strategies and enables the best one for your provider.
Magnifier — checking the availability of a specific site.
Battery — power-saving mode is active now (appears only while the mode runs; clicking opens settings).
Documents (sheet) — app logs with a category filter; you can also jump to the report from there.
Question — this help page.
